steps.text: Talk to Grish south of Castle Wars.
choices: Can I help in any way?
Ok, I'll check things out then and report back.
Yes, I want to help you out and find out about the zogres.

steps.text: Talk to the guard east of Grish.
Climb over the barricade east of Grish.
Climb down the stairs to the east.
Search the skeleton in the north west corner of this area.
Kill the zombie which appeared, and pick up the ruined backpack that appeared.
Open the backpack for a knife and a dragon inn tankard.
Search the broken lecturn in the north west corner of the tombs.
Search the ogre coffin next to the skeleton.
Use a knife on the ogre coffin next to the skeleton.
Search the coffin next to the skeleton again. It may take a few attempts to open.
Search the coffin for a black prism.
Talk to Zavistic Rarve at the Yanille Wizards' Guild. If you don't have 66 Magic, ring the bell outside the guild.
choices: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres

steps.text: Go upstairs and talk to Sithik in the house north of the Wizards' Guild.
Talk to Sithik Ints in the bed to the west.
choices: Do you mind if I look around?

steps.text: Search Sithik's wardrobe.
Search Sithik's cupboard.
Go upstairs and talk to Sithik in the house north of the Wizards' Guild.
Search Sithik's drawers for more papyrus.
The portrait drawn is wrong. Drop it and try drawing him again.
Use the papyrus on Sithik Ints.
Travel to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the dragon inn tankard on the bartender.
Use the portrait on the bartender.
Bring the books and signed portrait to Zavistic Rarve at the Yanille Wizards' Guild. If you don't have 66 Magic, ring the bell outside the guild.
choices: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres
I have some items that I'd like you to look at.

steps.text: Go upstairs and talk to Sithik in the house north of the Wizards' Guild.
Use the strange potion on the cup of tea next to Sithik.
Leave Sithik Int's house.
Go upstairs to Sithik again.
Talk to the transformed Sithik Ints for answers.
choices: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area?

steps.text: Talk to the transformed Sithik Ints for answers.
choices: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?

steps.text: Talk to the transformed Sithik Ints for answers.
choices: How do I get rid of the disease?

steps.text: Talk to Grish south of Castle Wars. Be prepared to fight Slash Bash. You'll need to use either brutal arrows or the Crumble Undead spell.
choices: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

steps.text: Talk to Grish south of Castle Wars again to learn how to make composite ogre bows.
choices: There must be an easier way to kill these zogres!

steps.text: Climb over the barricade east of Grish, prepared to fight Slash Bash.
Climb down the stairs to the east.
Enter the doors at the west side of the area.
Go down the stairs to the boss.
Search the stand in the north east corner, and kill Slash Bash when he spawns.
Pick up the ogre artefact.
Return to Grish with the ogre artefact.

items.name: Either brutal arrows or Crumble Undead for fighting Slash Bash

required.name: Either brutal arrows or Crumble Undead for fighting Slash Bash

rewards: Ability to fletch Comp Ogre Bows and Brutal Arrows
